name: Goretek HaulMaster Cargo Pant
description: Heavy-duty canvas cargo pants in faded olive or charcoal, built for long shifts on warehouse floors. Six deep pockets plus twin tool loops on the left thigh, reinforced stress points with bar-tack stitching. Most pairs show grease smears and faded wash marks that no cleaning cycle fully removes.
functionality: Tool loops, six deep pockets, bar-tack reinforced stress points
what_it_says: You work with your hands and you don't pretend otherwise.
story_hooks: A hidden pocket behind the left knee panel has been carefully hand-stitched shut — something was sewn inside and never retrieved.
Goretek runs a repair-and-return program; a worn pair exchanged at any depot comes back with fresh reinforcement and a new lot number stamped inside the waistband.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian workhorse silhouette—straight leg with pronounced cargo pocket architecture dominating the thigh and hip regions. Heavy, lived-in appearance that reads as functional rather than fashionable. Sits low on the waist with a relaxed, generous cut designed for movement and layered thermal wear underneath.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed and roomy through the thigh, with a straight taper to the ankle. Engineered for freedom of movement during extended shifts. Waistband sits at natural hip level; inseam generous enough to accommodate work boots.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-weight canvas blend (70% cotton, 30% synth-polymer), factory-treated for stain resistance but not fully effective against industrial oils and solvents.
physical_description.texture: Coarse canvas weave with visible thread detail. Surface shows subtle sheen from repeated washing and oil exposure. Bar-tack stitching creates slightly raised texture at stress points (seams, pocket corners, tool loops).
physical_description.color_scheme: Faded olive-drab or charcoal gray with organic wear patterns—darker grease marks concentrated around pocket edges and lower thigh, lighter fade marks across the seat and knees from continuous friction.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty brass zipper fly, reinforced snap waistband, belt loops at quarter-inch spacing for industrial-grade belts.
distinctive_features: Six oversized cargo pockets (two hip, two thigh, two rear)
Twin tool loops stitched onto left thigh for carabiners or wrenches
Bar-tack reinforcement at all stress points in contrasting thread
Permanent grease and chemical stains as patina
Slight pilling on inner thigh from friction with work chairs
Worn leather reinforcement patch on lower right calf (optional wear variant)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 (working class, logistics/manufacturing). Affordable, durable workwear that signals honest labor rather than corporate or street status.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by warehouse workers, Behemoth maintenance crews, shipping dock personnel, and logistics hub operators throughout the GLMZ. Signals reliability and physical work—the uniform of the unglamorous backbone of supply chains.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-worn and intentionally maintained in that state. New pairs look out of place; authenticity comes from visible stains, faded areas, and fraying at pocket edges. A pristine pair is a signal of recent hire or replacement.
